literal_meaning: তিনটি কুল বা বংশ (পিতৃকুল, মাতৃকুল ও শ্বশুরকুল)
figurative_meaning_en: paternal family, maternal family, and in-laws' family
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনকুলে তার কেউ নেই, তাই সে একা থাকে।
তার তিনকুলের সকল সদস্য একসাথে উৎসব করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no one in his three families, so he lives alone.
All members of his three families celebrate together.
note: Refers to the traditional Bengali emphasis on familial lineages and support systems.
